propertySets.name: Pset_EnergyRequirements
propertySets.definition: Property set for the application of energy requirements to facility and physical elements

properties.name: EnergySourceLabel
properties.definition: Type of energy source e.g. Electricity, Diesel, LPG etc. utilised by the element.

properties.name: EnergyConversionEfficiency
properties.definition: Measure of the efficiency of conversion of fuel energy to mechanical energy

propertySets.name: Pset_EnvironmentalEmissions
propertySets.definition: Property set for the application of energy emissions produced by facility and physical elements.

properties.name: CarbonDioxideEmissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of carbon dioxide

properties.name: SulphurDioxideEmissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of sulphur dioxide

properties.name: NitrogenOxidesEmissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of nitrogen oxides

properties.name: ParticulateMatterEmissions
properties.definition: Rate of emission of particulate matter

propertySets.name: Pset_ProcessCapacity
propertySets.definition: Property set for the application of process data to spatial elements and transport assets

properties.name: ProcessItem
properties.definition: The type of item (and its measurement method) being modelled within a process. This can be cargo, passengers or vehicles that pass through the system.

properties.name: ProcessCapacity
properties.definition: The number of units that can be processed in the time defined in ProcessPerformance

properties.name: ProcessPerformance
properties.definition: Minimum time to accept or dispatch the entire item capacity.

properties.name: DownstreamConnections
properties.definition: Names of downstream connected equipment and spaces, if not otherwise represented

properties.name: UpstreamConnections
properties.definition: Names of upstream connected equipment and spaces, if not otherwise represented

propertySets.name: Pset_TransportElementCommon
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcTransportElement or IfcTransportElementType

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: CapacityPeople
properties.definition: Capacity of the transportation element measured in numbers of person.

properties.name: CapacityWeight
properties.definition: Capacity of the transport element measured by weight.

properties.name: FireExit
properties.definition:
Indication whether this object is designed to serve as an exit in the case of fire (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

Here whether the transport element (in case of e.g., a lift) is designed to serve as a fire exit, e.g., for fire escape purposes.
